proposals.evidence: DEDR 3103 directly gives Tamil talai, Malayalam tala, Kannada tale, Tulu tare, Gondi tala/talla, Parji tel and Gadaba tallu ‘head’. The simple tal-/tel- survey forms agree in both stem and meaning; head-hair and head-fruit compounds are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 561 gives Tamil/Malayalam ukir, Kannada/Tulu ugur(u), Telugu/Konda gōru, Parji gēri and Kodagu oy ‘nail/claw’. The article expressly corrects Kurukh oṛox to orox; rhotic-nail responses requiring that transcription judgment are held separately, as are Sanskrit nakha loans. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
